sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Takeru also known as Lord Takeru, and Sakuza by O'Rin of the Water was a mentioned character.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Takeru was a champion and master swordsman samurai warrior, who be a first Divine Heir. He was killed by nobles of the Fountainhead Palace, just as Yashariku.
